generationNote: Curated for UI: structured SHAP factors only (no textual/SVM signals, no raw SHAP numbers), deduplicated by concept (see method), max 3 per direction, residual factors omitted below 20% of the top factor's magnitude or below an absolute floor of 0.003. v2.1.0 (presentation-only microajuste): adds an optional per-factor 'tooltip' string for visual/technical and sensitive variables — selection, dedup, and values are byte-identical to v2.0.0.
methodologicalNote: Estos factores reflejan patrones estadísticos aprendidos a partir de datos históricos. Indican cómo el modelo llegó a su predicción y no representan relaciones causales.
